name: rhizome
description: Personal long-horizon memory for AI agents, shared across agents and providers. Runs entirely on Cloudflare.

scripts.deploy: npm run build:web && node scripts/render-config.mjs && wrangler deploy -c wrangler.deploy.jsonc
scripts.migrate: node scripts/render-config.mjs && wrangler d1 migrations apply rhizome-control --remote -c wrangler.deploy.jsonc
scripts.check: tsc --noEmit && npm run build:web && node scripts/render-config.mjs && wrangler deploy -c wrangler.deploy.jsonc --dry-run --outdir .wrangler/dry-run
